|game_text=Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a non-[Theed Palace] senator for remainder of turn.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Astromech Shortage (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-31-Astromech_Shortage-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-astromechshortage-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-31-Astromech_Shortage.png]]) show the original text (see [[Astromech Shortage (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Astromech Shortage (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 31: “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a senator for remainder of turn.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) shows the same text.<ref name="cl-1210_31-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, slip marked E) changed “a senator” to “a non-[Theed Palace] senator”: “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a non-[Theed Palace] senator for remainder of turn.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
